CustomField.description: How many times a run that failed for a passing reason (app busy or down, no answer) is tried again (canonical model R-CR7), 0 to 4; blank or out of range reads as 3.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tries again after 15 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours and 12 hours, up to this many times.
CustomField.label: Retry Attempts
